Data:Slnev.ehsan.corso.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Corso are discussing the dreams they've had of the outer Mansus. Ehsan professes himself surprised to learn that he has less affinity for the Wood, and more for the Mansus, since he lost his skaptodon-hood. This last point clearly makes Corso uncomfortable: he moves his chair to sit a little farther from Ehsan. [Lesson: Watchman's Paradoxes]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.dagmar.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Dagmar are discussing an exhibition of paintings influenced (they suspect) by the work of Julian Coseley. 'Didn't much like it,' Dagmar pronounces. 'Bureau'll shut it down soon enough. No great loss. Enough ugly things in the world.' She pales in horror as she realises she's talking to the ugliest person in the room; she starts to apologise; she starts to apologise for apologising. Ehsan chuckles like gravel. After a moment, Dagmar chuckles too. [Lesson: Sights & Sensations]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.douglas.json.startdescription: Ehsan needs to travel to Zurich, and wants to know whether Douglas 'cousins of the duties' might arrest him. Douglas works through what he calls his 'abominations checklist'; regretfully, he tells Ehsan that yes, they probably will. (He suggests that Ehsan not tell him which train he's catching.)  [Lesson: Purifications & Exaltations]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.fraser.json.startdescription: Fraser is experiencing pain in the altered joints of the hand that he prefers to keep gloved; Ehsan has some advice. [Lesson: Herbs & Infusions]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.hokobald.json.startdescription: Hokobald admits in a subterranean growl that even though - or perhaps - because of his Forge-long status, the sea airs of Brancrug cause his joints to stiffen. 'To rust, perhaps?' Ehsan enquires blandly. In response to Hokobald's glare, he apologises, and prescribes a tisane. [Lesson: Herbs & Infusions]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.morgen.json.startdescription: Morgen offers opinions on the origins of striges, the 'vermin of the lower heavens'; Ehsan respectfully dissents. 'The Lionsmith may have changed them, but he never made them.' [Lesson: Strings & Songs]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.olympe.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Olympe discuss the lunatic theories of the heresiarch Cygnifer. Olympe mentions that the connection Cygnifer draws between amber and the city Ys - the city beyond the wave - and admits that this connection has always made intuitive sense to her, though she can't explain why... [Lesson: Anbary & Lapidary]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.serena.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Serena reminisce about their time at Hush House in the days of its power, when the winds were leashed to keep the seas safe, when the Fine-Takers still responded to the words of the Covenant… [Lesson: Sacra Solis Invicti]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.stanislav.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Stanislav brag cheerfully to each other about the maladies they've defeated. Ehsan describes a gnathobasic debasement that he had to purify with wasps and wine; Stanislav claims to have driven a bloodlines infection out of a patient using 'reasoned debate.' [Lesson: Surgeries & Exsanguinations]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Denzil and Ehsan speak in hushed, respectful tones of Mrs Kille's celebrated fish galettes. [Lesson: Sea Stories]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Mr Kille discuss freshwater fishing. (Mr Kille admits that he has never gone out on a fishing boat: too many stories about the seas near Brancrug Isle.) [Lesson: Sea Stories]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Timothy has come to understand that Ehsan was once something else, although he is not clear exactly what that was, and Ehsan is not particularly eager to enlighten him. He asks what it is like, the change in life. Ehsan leans back, and declares - or perhaps quotes - a little melodramatically: 'The sea does not regret the tide, and after the tide withdraws, something always remains, which we call memory.' That is the last thing he has to say on the matter, and against his silence, Timothy's questions fall like rain.

Data:Slnev.ehsan.yvette.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Yvette speak of Tentreto, the perhaps-human saint of the early church. Ehsan describes his pilgrimage to Tentreto's shrine in Venice, but admits he was motivated only partly by religious curiosity - more by an enthusiasm for Venetian cuisine and a desire to catch up with an old (he coughs in embarrassment) friend... [Lesson: Pearl & Tide]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.zachary.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Zachary discuss Illopoly's line - after Husher: 'the White is West of the World, and Winter does not wait forever.' Zachary says suddenly that he would like to paint the White; Ehsan gently encourages him; they discuss the palest pigments. [Lesson: Sights & Sensations]

Data:Slnev.fraser.agdistis.json.startdescription: Agdistis and Fraser have returned to their discussion of the prospective ballet for which Fraser wishes to act as impresario. Agdistis has finally agreed to act as choreographer, but only on condition that he can veto Fraser's initial choice of name, which he strongly dislikes: 'The Buzzing in the Skull.' [Lesson: Purifications & Exaltations]

Data:Slnev.fraser.aladim.json.startdescription: Al-Adim and Fraser are debating - very cautiously, even here in Hush House - the nature of the Red Flower of the Calyptra - to what extent it makes use of the cleansing fire, and to what extent it relies on illusion and deception. [Lesson: Inks of Power]

Data:Slnev.fraser.arthur.json.startdescription: Arthur and Fraser are discussing the Althiban Abyss near Baghdad. Fraser hopes the power that stirs there might be connected to the Carapace Cross, but Arthur firmly dissuades him: if once it was Cross, he says, it belongs to something else now. [Lesson: Coil & Chasm]

Data:Slnev.fraser.arun.json.startdescription: Fraser is speaking to Arun of the changes he's been undergoing as his inner nature becomes more manifest. He speaks with obvious pride; but he's concerned that his body might have begun to produce a venom, and he's not sure what to do about it… [Lesson: Serpents & Venoms]

Data:Slnev.fraser.azita.json.startdescription: Fraser and Azita are negotiating something shady-sounding about mammoth ivory and dreams of ice… [Lesson: Horns & Ivories]

Data:Slnev.fraser.chaima.json.startdescription: Chaima is commissioning 'noble ammunition' from Fraser, for prey which isn't so very bothered by the usual sort of bullet. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Hammer]

Data:Slnev.fraser.connie.json.startdescription: Fraser wants to view exhibits from the Bureau's White Museum: the remains of animals who've undergone a Cross-change. He is arguing persuasively that he might be of assistance, but Connie is sceptical. [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.fraser.coquille.json.startdescription: Fraser asks Coquille to advise him on some Eastern pieces he has recently purchased, which he hopes may be pentiments of the Sixth History… [Lesson: Pentiments & Precursors]

Data:Slnev.fraser.corso.json.startdescription: Corso has an unusual Book of Suns for sale, 'collated' by a mysterious pilgrim of Antaian heritage. Fraser is interested, but wants to speak to its collator. Corso shakes his head: 'My clients pay for my discretion.' [Lesson: Pentiments & Precursors]

Data:Slnev.fraser.dagmar.json.startdescription: Fraser wishes to commission Dagmar to inspect his security arrangement. He is particularly concerned about intruders using the key-weapons known as frangiclaves, and about the Ligeians with their Keys, though Dagmar scoffs: 'Ligeians won't care about your collection one way or another.' [Lesson: Lockworks & Clockworks]

Data:Slnev.fraser.dagmar.morgen.json.startdescription: Fraser wishes to commission Dagmar to inspect his security arrangement. He is particularly concerned about intruders using the key-weapons known as frangiclaves, and about the Ligeians with their Keys, though Dagmar scoffs: 'Ligeians won't care about your collection one way or another.' Across the room, Morgen tilts her head and winks. [Lesson: Lockworks & Clockworks]

Data:Slnev.fraser.douglas.json.startdescription: Fraser complains to Douglas about break-ins. Douglas unsympathetically suggests that Fraser might want to keep less contraband on the premises, then. [Lesson: Wolf Stories]

Data:Slnev.fraser.ehsan.json.startdescription: Fraser and Ehsan are discussing tarascisation and 'la malaise raveline' - the horrible changes that occur in certain families that have conducted 'traffic with beasts'. [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.fraser.hokobald.json.startdescription: Fraser and Hokobald bicker about whether Henavek - the language-spirit sometimes called 'the Eldest' belongs to the Wood or to the Mansus. [Lesson: Henavek]

Data:Slnev.fraser.morgen.json.startdescription: Fraser expounds his theories on the naming of earthquakes - the origin of the limited roster of names that (he believes) all new earthquakes draw from. Morgen insists that there are no new earthquakes, except, now and then, under the sea when another of the Blackbone's limbs is further fractured. [Lesson: Hill & Hollow]

Data:Slnev.fraser.olympe.json.startdescription: Olympe and Fraser discuss asimel and ashartine. Olympe confesses in a rush that she can never remember which is which; after an agonising moment, Fraser shakes his head and admits 'No more can I.' They grin at each other. [Lesson: Inks of Revelation]

Data:Slnev.fraser.serena.json.startdescription: Fraser and Serena speak of Antaios, who might have been a child of Name-emanations of the Flint and Wheel. Fraser wonders why, if Antaios' forebears were immortal, they did not suffer the urge to devour him. Serena provokingly asks when he thinks the Crime of the Sky first became a Crime... [Lesson: Stone Stories]

Data:Slnev.fraser.stanislav.json.startdescription: Fraser and Stanislav discuss the Unnumbered Stones of Brittany, not far from Stanislav's current digs. Fraser insists they were placed by the Carapace Cross. Stanislav humours him. [Lesson: Stone Stories]

Data:Slnev.fraser.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Fraser returns to the subject of mining, and of Denzil's family connections with tinners. Evidently he has commercial ambitions in this part of the world… Denzil answers him, albeit reluctantly. [Lesson: Coil & Chasm]

Data:Slnev.fraser.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Fraser quizzes Mrs Kille about her dreams; particuarly any dreams she can remember from her childhood; and in particular whether she can recall any 'dreams of eyes'. Mrs Kille answers in detail, but without friendliness. [Lesson: Pentiments & Precursors]

Data:Slnev.fraser.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Timothy - an admirer of Christopher Illopoly's work - has learnt that Illopoly was adopted by Fraser Strathcoyne, and has many, many questions for Fraser about Illopoly's education and career. Fraser answers them in reasonably good temper until Timothy guilelessly asks why Illopoly now uses a different surname. [Lesson: Auroral Contemplations]

Data:Slnev.fraser.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette is asking Fraser about his 'dreams of eyes'. He is eager to tell her - he interprets them as messages from the 'greater hybridity' of the Carapace Cross, though she is sceptical. [Lesson: Hill & Hollow]

Data:Slnev.fraser.zachary.json.startdescription: Fraser inquires - sometimes tactfully - about Zachary's condition, what exactly he bears within him, what dangers it might present, and what it might become. Zachary answers - always cautiously and elliptically. [Lesson: Serpents & Venoms]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.agdistis.json.startdescription: Hokobald and Agdistis discuss the possibility of a ballet of bells. Agdistis becomes sufficiently engaged to smile at Hokobald, despite his clear suspicion of that corrupt immortal… [Lesson: Bells & Brazieries]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.aladim.json.startdescription: Hokobald speaks to al-Adim of the final Pilgrimage of Seven that the Vagabond supposedly intends - up the Mansus and beyond, into the Glory. He gloatingly explains why he believes her Pilgrimage will fail. Al-Adim disagrees; he thinks that, eventually, it will succeed; but the prospect clearly makes him unhappy. (It may be, in fact, that this was Hokobald's intention in raising the matter...) [Lesson: Path & Pilgrim]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.arthur.json.startdescription: Hokobald picks up where he left off, lecturing Arthur on the strategies of the Leashed Flame in the War of the Roads in a knowledgeable but hectoring sort of way. Arthur, again, listens politely; but bridles when Hokobald speaks sneeringly of the Flame's remnant, the Endeavour Club, where Arthur has friends. Hokobald becomes scaldingly contemptuous; Arthur, bitterly polite; and the converation ends. [Lesson: Meniscate Reflections]
